description: TokenDance AgentHub Renovate config. CI5 lane pilot: npm patch + gomod managers first. Patch auto-merges only after the checks workflow is green; minor is a weekly review PR; major is a standalone review PR. Expo major and Storybook major are excluded (migration owned by separate lanes).

packageRules.description: Patch updates: weekly, auto-merge after CI (checks workflow) is green. Patch-only is safe enough to merge unattended; minor/major are NOT in this rule.
Minor updates: weekly grouped review PR, no auto-merge.
Major updates: each in its own PR for focused review, no auto-merge.
Exclude Expo major bumps — mobile ecosystem major migration is owned by the mobile lane, not Renovate.
Exclude Storybook major bumps — 8.x to 10.x migration is deferred and owned separately.
vite / typescript majors are deferred (vite 6->8, TS 5->7 carry large migration surface).
